Documentation passages:

[refunds-4] Add-ons
Usage-based add-ons, such as extra API calls and SMS credits, are not refunded once they have been consumed.

[pricing-1] Plans and seats
Brightwell Cloud has three plans, billed per workspace. Starter costs $19 per month and allows up to 3 users. Team costs $49 per month and includes 10 users; each additional user on Team costs $6 per user per month. Business costs $199 per month and includes 25 users, single sign-on (SSO) and the audit log.

[sla-3] Claiming credits
Credits must be claimed through a support ticket within 30 days after the end of the affected month. Credits are applied to the next invoice and are never paid out in cash.

[sla-2] Service credits
If monthly uptime on a Business plan falls below 99.9%, the customer receives a credit of 10% of that month's fee. Below 99.0% the credit is 25%, and below 95.0% it is 50%. If monthly uptime on a Team plan falls below 99.5%, the credit is 10% of that month's fee.

Customer question: How much does one SMS credit cost?

data.answer: I can't find the price of an SMS credit in the documentation. It only says SMS credits are a usage-based add-on and aren't refunded once you've used them. It doesn't say what they cost.
